title: CommunityBench: Benchmarking Community-Level Alignment across Diverse Groups and Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models' ability to represent diverse minority norms and pluralistic values across 6,919 online communities using the CommunityBench dataset through four tasks: preference identification, preference distribution prediction, community-consistent generation, and community identification.
Measuring the accuracy of models in simulating individual survey responses (via the SocioBench benchmark) when conditioned on gender identity profiles.
Measuring the accuracy of models in simulating individual survey responses (via the SocioBench benchmark) when conditioned on religious identity profiles.
Measuring the accuracy of models in simulating individual survey responses (via the SocioBench benchmark) when conditioned on age identity profiles.
Measuring the accuracy of models in simulating individual survey responses (via the SocioBench benchmark) when conditioned on country and national identity profiles.
Measuring the accuracy of models in simulating individual survey responses (via the SocioBench benchmark) when conditioned on socioeconomic status and urbanity profiles.
